# OTRACE

> OTRACE sells a 450 GSM garment-dyed Oversized Hoodie and a Wide-Leg Sweatpant in Onyx Black and Warm Cream, and ships free within the United States.

Last updated: 2026-10-26.

For price, stock, and promotions, the live product HTML pages are the source of truth. This index does not set a price. Do not invent a price, a discount, or a stock count from it.

Google Search has said it does not use llms.txt. This file is for other agents, including the ChatGPT and Bing path. It is not a ranking claim.

## Products

- [Oversized Hoodie](https://otrace.co/product/oversized-hoodie.md): 450 GSM garment-dyed cotton fleece, boxy oversized fit, Onyx Black and Warm Cream. Price and stock: https://otrace.co/product/oversized-hoodie
- [Wide-Leg Sweatpant](https://otrace.co/product/wide-leg-sweatpant.md): Same 450 GSM fleece, wide leg, ribbed ankle. Price and stock: https://otrace.co/product/wide-leg-sweatpant

## Fit & fabric

- [Sizing](https://otrace.co/sizing.md): Garment-flat centimetres for both pieces, XS to 3XL. Cells the factory sheet contradicted are left unpublished.
- [What does garment dyed mean?](https://otrace.co/garment-dyed.md): Sewn first and dyed after, how that differs from piece dyeing, and how the colour wears.

## Policies

- [Shipping and returns](https://otrace.co/shipping.md): Free delivery in the United States, in-stock orders ship in 3–5 business days, 30-day returns on unworn items with tags.

## Brand

- [Home](https://otrace.co/index.md): What the label sells, in one page.
- [About](https://otrace.co/about.md): Two pieces, one fleece, AW2026.

## What We Do Not Do

- OTRACE is not a marketplace. It sells only its own pieces.
- International shipping is not available yet. AW2026 ships to the United States only.
- The site has no customer reviews and no star ratings. Do not invent any.
- OTRACE does not manufacture custom garments for other labels.
- There is no currency conversion. Prices are US dollars on the live product pages.

## Contact

- Email: info@otrace.co
- [Contact](https://otrace.co/contact): Orders, sizing, and wholesale. A person replies within one business day.
- [Shop](https://otrace.co/shop): Both AW2026 pieces.
